pattern.short_summary: A property of the system or of its output is bound to an ordered control the user sets to a value — a slider, a numbered keypress, a discrete set of levels, a spatial distance.
pattern.definition: A property of the system or of its output is bound to an ordered control the user sets to a value — a slider, a numbered keypress, a discrete set of levels, a spatial distance. Setting the value re-runs or re-renders under the new setting. The dimension exists before any particular content and persists across generations.
pattern.structural_signature: A named parameter with an ordered range (short/moderate/long; 1D distance; temperature; abstraction level) is surfaced as a persistent control widget bound to that range. The control does not create content; it scales an already-defined property of whatever content is produced, and the same control is available for every output. Multiple such parameters may be exposed together as a configuration panel.

dimension.category_description: How users, artifacts, examples, parameters, or user-state signals specify intent and shape the system's next behavior.
dimension.classification_boundary: Requires a user-facing specification or adaptive interaction; invisible sensing infrastructure is excluded.
